blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Long contexts enlarge key--value (KV) caches, increasing memory use and attention costs during generation. Compressing these caches must preserve information for unseen questions. We introduce **Latent Compaction**, which learns a compact document-specific cache through test-time training. We initialize cache entries using reconstruction importance, teacher attention, and key-space diversity. Training first fits attention outputs and log-normalizers to those of the full cache, with reconstruction-selected entries held fixed. It then jointly optimizes the entire cache through end-to-end distillation from the full-cache model. Model weights remain frozen throughout, and training uses only generic prompts about the document, without access to downstream questions or answers. Experiments on RULER, LongBench, and Phonebook Lookup demonstrate substantial gains over budget-matched compression baselines. On a RULER, for example, our method achieves 96.7% accuracy at 32$\times$ compression, compared with 40.0% for KVZip+. The method also transfers across model scales and families, with retrieval gains on both Qwen3 and MiniCPM5. These results show that treating the KV cache as a neural network and optimizing it with test-time training can preserve retrieval accuracy under aggressive compression. The code is released at https://www.github.com/THUNLP/latent-compaction
blocks.zh: 长时间上下文扩大了密钥值(KV)缓存,在生成过程中增加了内存的使用和注意力成本. 压缩这些缓存必须保存信息以进行隐蔽的问题. 我们采用**Latent Concession**,它通过测试时间培训学习一个紧凑的文件特定缓存。 我们利用重建的重要性、老师的注意和密钥空间的多样性来初始化缓存条目。 培训首先使注意力输出和对数常态化与全部缓存输出匹配,并固定了重建选定的条目。 然后通过从全卡切模型的端到端蒸馏来联合优化整个缓存. 模型重量在整个过程中一直处于冻结状态,培训只使用关于文件的通用提示,无法进入下游问答. 对RULAR、Long Bench和Phonebook Lookup的实验表明,在预算匹配的压缩基线方面有相当大的进展。 例如,在RULAR上,我们的方法在32美元/时压缩时达到96.7%的精度,而KVZip+的精度为40.0%。 该方法还跨模型尺度和家庭转移,在Qune3和MiniCPM5上都有检索收益。 这些结果表明,将KV缓存作为神经网络处理,并通过测试时间训练优化它,可以在积极的压缩下保持检索精度. 该代码在https://www.github.com/THUNLP/latent-compaction上发布.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Large key–value (KV) caches are a major bottleneck to efficient LLM inference: long contexts limit batch sizes and increase memory-bandwidth demands at each decoding step ( Zhang et al., 2023 ; Liu et al., 2024 ) , motivating context compression.
blocks.zh: 大键—值(KV)缓存是高效LLM推论的一大瓶颈: 长上下文限制批量大小,增加每个解码步骤的内存带宽要求(张等人,2023年;刘等人,2024年),激励上下文压缩.

blocks.en: Frontier-model platforms already offer context compaction to sustain conversations beyond a single context window ( Anthropic, 2026 ; OpenAI, 2026 ) . Claude, for example, replaces older context with a text summary. Summaries can omit details whose importance only becomes clear later ( Anthropic, 2025 ) , motivating compression of the model’s KV representation directly. We study document compression before downstream questions arrive: the cache must preserve information for unseen queries, while preparation costs can be amortized across repeated use.
blocks.zh: Frontier-model平台已经提供上下文压缩功能,以维持单个上下文窗口以外的对话(Anthropic, 2026;OpenAI, 2026). 例如,克劳德用一个文本摘要来代替旧上下文. 简况可以省略一些细节, 其重要性在稍后才变得清晰(Anthropic, 2025), 我们在下游问题到来之前研究文件压缩:缓存必须保存信息以进行隐蔽的查询,而制备成本可以通过反复使用进行摊销.

blocks.en: Eviction methods select original KV entries using attention or reconstruction ( Li et al., 2024 ; Cai et al., 2025 ; Kim et al., 2025 ) . Cartridges learns compact caches through self-study ( Eyuboglu et al., 2025 ) , while Attention Matching fits attention outputs and mass ( Zweiger et al., 2026 ) . These approaches motivate test-time training of document memory ( Sun et al., 2020 ) : can gradient descent on a compact KV cache preserve document information under an aggressive memory budget?
blocks.zh: 驱逐方法利用注意或重建选择原始KV条目(Li等人,2024年;Cai等人,2025年;Kim等人,2025年)。 Cartridges通过自学学习紧凑缓存(Eyuboglu等人,2025年),而注意力匹配则符合注意力输出和质量(Zweiger等人,2026年). 这些方法激励了文件存储器的测试时间培训(Sun等人,2020年):在紧凑的KV缓存上梯度下降能否在积极的内存预算下保存文件信息?

blocks.en: We introduce Latent Compaction , which trains a document-specific KV cache with frozen model weights. Initialization combines globally selected preservers with anchors and diversifiers. Stage 1 fixes preservers and fits the other entries to full-cache attention outputs and log-normalizers. Stage 2 jointly optimizes all entries using the model’s predictions on generic document prompts. Downstream questions and answers are excluded; the trained cache is fixed during reuse. For a 4K document at 32 × 32\times compression, each layer/head averages 96 preservers and 32 anchors and diversifiers.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍Latent Concession, 它训练一个文件专用的 KV 缓存 和冻结的模型重量。 初始化结合了全球选定的保护者与锚和潜水者. 第1阶段将保存器固定,并与其他条目匹配到全缓存注意力输出和日志正常化器. 第2阶段利用模型对通用文档提示的预测,共同优化所有条目。 下游问答不包括在内;经过训练的缓存在再利用时固定. 对于一个以32×32\时间压缩的4K文档,每层/头平均有96个保存器和32个锚和潜水器.

blocks.en: Experiments on RULER, LongBench, and Phonebook Lookup demonstrate the benefits of Latent Compaction across synthetic retrieval and natural-document understanding tasks. The method substantially improves retrieval accuracy over budget-matched compression baselines across context lengths and compression ratios, while LongBench results show gains on broader long-context tasks. Additional Phonebook Lookup experiments demonstrate transfer across model scales and families: the retrieval advantages extend to multiple Qwen3 model sizes and MiniCPM5 models. Ablations identify the roles of initialization, both training stages, and attention normalization. These results concern logical KV-pair budgets rather than measured memory savings or inference speedups.
blocks.zh: 对RULAR、Long Bench和Phonebook Lookup的实验表明,Latent Concession在合成检索和自然文件理解任务方面的益处。 该方法大大改进了跨上下文长度和压缩比率的预算匹配压缩基线的检索准确性,而Long Bench的结果表明,在更广泛的长文字任务方面有所改进。 额外的Phonebook Lookup实验证明了跨模型尺度和家庭的转移:检索优势扩展到多个Qune3模型大小和MiniCPM5模型. 差距确定了初始化的作用,包括培训阶段和注意力正常化。 这些结果涉及逻辑KV-pair预算,而不是计量内存节省或推论速度加快.

blocks.en: Our contributions are: • A novel method for learning compact context representation trained with gradient descent and initialized through complementary selection rules. • A document-specific test-time training procedure that learns from the frozen model’s attention and predictions without access to downstream questions or answers. • Superior performance on a wide range of empirical downstream evaluation across three benchmarks and multiple model scales and families, with ablations of initialization, training, and attention normalization.
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献是: 学习紧凑背景代表的新方法,经过梯度递减培训,通过补充性甄选规则初始化。 • 支助 一个针对文件的测试时间训练程序,从冷冻模型的注意和预测中吸取教训,而无法获得下游的问答. • 在三个基准和多个模式规模及家庭的广泛下游实证评价中取得更好的业绩,同时进行初始化、培训和注意力正常化。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Eviction methods retain selected original KV pairs. H 2 O combines recent and high-attention tokens ( Zhang et al., 2023 ) , while SnapKV selects positions using an observation window ( Li et al., 2024 ) . PyramidKV varies budgets across layers ( Cai et al., 2025 ) , and Ada-KV adapts budgets across heads ( Feng et al., 2025 ) . KVZip scores each entry by its maximum attention weight during context reconstruction ( Kim et al., 2025 ) . KVZip+, introduced by Jégou and Jeblick (2026) , rescales each weight by the projected value norm divided by the input hidden-state norm before taking the maximum. This accounts for each value’s relative contribution to the residual stream. Their KVzap method learns lightweight predictors of these scores to accelerate pruning. We use KVZip+ scores to initialize preservers before cache optimization. We evaluate query-agnostic SnapKV and PyramidKV adaptations that withhold downstream questions.
blocks.zh: 退出方法保留选定的原始KV对. H2O结合了近代和高关注度的代币(Zhang等人,2023年),而SnapKV则使用观测窗口选择位置(Li等人,2024年). PyramidKV各层预算不同(Cai等人,2025年),Ada-KV对各层预算进行调整(Feng等人,2025年)。 KVZip在上下文重建(Kim et al., 2025)期间按其最大注意力重量对每个条目进行评分. KVZip+,由Jégou和Jeblick(2026)引入,在取最大值前按输入隐藏状态规范除以预测值规范对每个条目进行调整. 这说明每一价值对剩余流的相对贡献。 他们的KVzap方法学习了这些分数的轻量级预测器以加速螺旋. 我们使用KVZip+分数在缓存优化前初始化保存器. 我们评价那些拒绝下游问题的 查询不可知的 SnapKV 和 PyramidKV 适应性。

blocks.en: Prefix-tuning optimizes continuous prefixes with frozen model weights ( Li and Liang, 2021 ) . AutoCompressors and the In-context Autoencoder learn compression mechanisms across examples, producing compact summary vectors or memory slots ( Chevalier et al., 2023 ; Ge et al., 2024 ) . Cartridges instead optimizes a compact KV cache for an individual corpus through self-study and context distillation ( Eyuboglu et al., 2025 ) . Attention Matching fits full-cache attention outputs and mass through key selection, biases, and values ( Zweiger et al., 2026 ) . Our related stage-1 loss is followed by end-to-end refinement of all entries. RestoreKV generates restoration entries using a shared LoRA mechanism ( Baek et al., 2026 ) ; we optimize document-specific slots directly.
blocks.zh: 前缀调制优化连续前缀 冷冻型号重量(李和良,2021). AutoCompressors和in-context Autoencoder学习跨例压缩机制,生成紧凑的简要矢量或内存槽(Chevalier等人,2023年;Ge等人,2024年). 相反,Cartridges通过自学和上下文蒸馏优化了个人体的紧凑KV缓存(Eyuboglu等人,2025年)。 通过关键选择、偏见和价值观,将注意力匹配到全切注意产出和质量(Zweiger等人,2026年)。 相关阶段一损失后,所有条目的端对端完善. RepresentKV使用共享的LORA机制(Baek等人,2026年)生成恢复条目;我们直接优化文档特定槽.

blocks.en: Test-time training (TTT) adapts model parameters using a self-supervised objective on an unlabeled test input before prediction ( Sun et al., 2020 ) . For language models, Hardt and Sun (2024) fine-tune model weights on retrieved nearest-neighbor text for each test input. TTT layers make an online-learned model the recurrent hidden state ( Sun et al., 2025 ) , while TTT-E2E updates Transformer weights on the input context through next-token prediction, with a meta-learned initialization ( Tandon et al., 2025 ) . Latent Compaction instead updates document-specific KV slots in an existing frozen Transformer, using full-cache teacher attention and predictions. It prepares the compact cache before downstream questions are known and reuses that cache across questions without further optimization.
blocks.zh: 测试时间培训(TTT)在预测前使用无标签测试输入上的自我监督目标来调整模型参数(Sun等人,2020年). 对于语言模型,Hardt和Sun(2024年)在检索到的近邻文本上微调模型权重,每个测试输入. TTT层使一个在线学习模型成为经常性的隐藏状态(Sun等人,2025年),而TT-E2E则通过下位预测更新变形器对输入环境的权重,并进行元学习初始化(Tandon等人,2025年). 相反,Latent Concession更新了现有冷冻变形器中文档专用的 KV 插槽,使用全缓存老师的注意力和预测. 它在知道下游问题之前准备紧凑缓存,并在不作进一步优化的情况下重复存储所有问题。

blocks.en: Latent Compaction constructs a compact, trainable KV cache for a document before downstream questions arrive. Model weights remain frozen throughout, and the optimized cache is reused across questions.
blocks.zh: Lateent Concession 在下游问题到来之前为文档构建一个可训练的密钥 KV 。 模型重量在整个过程中一直处于冻结状态,优化的缓存被跨问题重复使用.

blocks.en: In what follows, Section 3.1 defines the memory architecture and its interaction with subsequent tokens. Section 3.2 explains the preserver, anchor, and diversifier initialization and budget allocation. Sections 3.3 and 3.4 describe attention fitting and end-to-end refinement, respectively. Section 3.5 details the generic teacher rollouts that provide supervision for both stages.

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验装置

blocks.en: Unless otherwise stated, we use Qwen3-1.7B with frozen model weights, BF16 model computation, and an FP32 KV cache. Each document receives 480 generic teacher prompts with continuations of up to 24 tokens. We use 1,000 attention-fitting (stage 1) updates per layer and 1,000 end-to-end refinement (stage 2) updates, with constant AdamW learning rates of 3 × 10 − 3 3\times 10^{-3} and 10 − 4 10^{-4} , respectively. We use one paired seed per document and fixed schedules without downstream-question-based checkpoint selection. Appendix A gives implementation details.
blocks.zh: 除非另有说明,否则我们使用带有冻结模型权重的Quen3–1.7B,BF16模型计算,以及一个FP32 KV缓存. 每份文件都收到480个普通教师提示,续作多达24个信使. 我们使用1000个关注调整(第1阶段)每层更新和1000个端对端更新(第2阶段),亚当W的恒定学习率分别为3×10−3×3×3×3×3×3×3×3×3}和10×4×10×4}. 我们每份文件和固定时间表使用一对种子,而不选择基于下游问题的检查站。 附 录 A提供实施细节。

blocks.en: We compare KVZip+, Attention Matching, SnapKV, and PyramidKV ( Kim et al., 2025 ; Jégou and Jeblick, 2026 ; Zweiger et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2024 ; Cai et al., 2025 ) , plus full-cache and text-summary references. Our Attention Matching baseline uses the repeat-prefill, highest-attention-key variant. Every method compresses the document before seeing the evaluation question. SnapKV and PyramidKV therefore use query-agnostic adaptations. Text summaries may fall below the target token budget; summaries that exceed it are truncated to that budget. For target context length N 0 N_{0} and compression ratio r r , the source budget is B = N 0 / r B=N_{0}/r KV pairs per layer and KV head, counting all three entry types for Latent Compaction. Reported ratios use this target length; for an actual document length N N , the KV-pair compression ratio is N / B N/B . Question and generated-token caches are excluded. This is a logical KV-pair budget; physical memory also depends on precision, biases, and padding.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了KVZip+,注意匹配,SnapKV,和PyramidKV(Kim等人,2025年;Jégou和Jeblick,2026年;Zweiger等人,2026年;Li等人,2024年;Cai等人,2025年),加上全cache和文本摘要参考. 我们的注意匹配基准 使用重复预填, 最高的注意键变体。 每一种方法都会在看到评价问题之前压缩文档. 因此,SnapKV和PyramidKV使用查询-不可知的适应. 文本摘要可能低于目标符号预算;超出该数字的概要将缩短为该预算。 对于目标上下文长度N 0 N_{0}和压缩比r r,源预算为B = N 0 / r B = N_{0}/r KV对每层和KV头,计算Latent Contaction的所有三种条目类型. 报告比率使用这个目标长度;对于实际文件长度N N ,KV-pair压缩比为N / B N/B. 询问和生成的键缓存不在此列. 这是一个逻辑的 KV- pair 预算; 物理内存也取决于精度, 偏差, 和粘贴 。

blocks.en: 4.2 Evaluation benchmarks and metrics
blocks.zh: 4.2 评价基准和衡量标准

blocks.en: We evaluate on three benchmarks: • RULER ( Hsieh et al., 2024 ) . This suite contains 13 synthetic long-context tasks. For each compression ratio, we evaluate 20 documents per task–length pair and report aggregate and per-task scores. Appendix E reports the per-task results. • LongBench ( Bai et al., 2024 ) . We use this benchmark to evaluate long-context understanding on natural documents. We vary the compression ratio while keeping the evaluation documents fixed and report LongBench scores. • Phonebook Lookup ( Jelassi et al., 2024 ) . Each document maps names to phone numbers. Given a name, the model must retrieve the corresponding number. We report lookup accuracy.
blocks.zh: 我们按三个基准进行评估: 欧盟驻科法治团(Hsieh等人,2024年)。 这套套装包含13个合成长文本任务. 对于每个压缩比,我们每个任务对20份文件进行评估,并报告汇总和每个任务得分。 附录E报告每个任务的结果。 • Long Bench(Bai等人,2024年). 我们利用这一基准来评价对自然文件的长期理解。 我们改变压缩比率,同时保持评价文件的固定,并报告Long Bench的得分。 • 电话簿查询 (Jelassi等人,2024年). 每个文档将名称映射到电话号码. 给一个名字,模型必须检索相应的号码. 我们报告检查的准确性。

blocks.en: Figure 1 compares methods across compression ratios at 16K context and across context lengths at 16 × 16\times and 32 × 32\times compression. Latent Compaction generally retains more accuracy than the compression baselines, with particularly large gains on Phonebook Lookup at 16 × 16\times compression. The advantage is not uniform: text summarization outperforms Latent Compaction on RULER at the most aggressive ratios, and all compressed methods approach zero Phonebook Lookup accuracy at 64 × 64\times compression and beyond.

blocks.en: Figure 3 compares LongBench scores for Qwen3-0.6B, 1.7B, and 4B at 4 × 4\times – 32 × 32\times compression. Latent Compaction outperforms text summarization throughout and KVZip+ at 16 × 16\times and 32 × 32\times for all three models. At 4 × 4\times , its scores are close to KVZip+, but its advantage grows under stronger compression, particularly for the 0.6B and 4B models. Scores still decline as compression increases, leaving a gap to the uncompressed models. These results extend the retrieval findings to natural-document understanding, while showing the cost of aggressive compression.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: Latent Compaction trains reusable document KV caches with frozen model weights through attention fitting and distillation. RULER, LongBench, and Phonebook Lookup show accuracy gains under compression; ablations highlight initialization and attention normalization. Per-document fitting remains costly and extreme compression hurts accuracy. Future work will reduce preparation cost and study broader tasks.
blocks.zh: Lententnt Concession列车通过注意力安装和蒸馏可重复使用 KV 文档缓存,并带有冷冻模型重量. RULER、Long Bench和Phonebook Lookup在压缩下显示精度提高;模拟突出初始化和注意力正常化。 每个文件的装配成本仍然很高,极端压缩会损害准确性。 今后的工作将减少准备费用并研究更广泛的任务。

blocks.en: • Document and teacher prompts. We tokenize each document as raw text, without a chat template or added special tokens, and prefill it once. We do not concatenate different documents or teacher prompts into a single sequence. Each of the 480 prompts starts from an independent fork of that document’s full cache; generation stops at EOS or 24 tokens. The fitting code does not truncate document or prompt tokens, so inputs must fit the model’s supported context length. • Stage 1. Query vectors captured from all prompt–continuation rollouts are concatenated along the query-position axis for each layer. If this pool exceeds 4,096 positions, we retain 4,096 evenly spaced positions. Each update samples up to 128 query positions with replacement, shared across the layer’s heads. Full-cache attention targets are computed in chunks of 16 query positions to limit temporary memory. • Stage 2. Each update samples four rollouts with replacement. For each rollout, the input is its prompt concatenated with the preceding teacher-generated tokens; the document is supplied through the compacted cache. The model processes each rollout separately with a fresh continuation cache and a sequence batch size of one. Its loss is divided by four, and gradients from all four rollouts are accumulated before clipping and one AdamW step. Variable-length rollouts are neither padded together nor packed into a shared attention sequence. Distillation uses the teacher’s top 20 probabilities and aggregate tail mass, plus next-token cross-entropy (Section 3.4 ).

The fitting code does not truncate document or prompt tokens, so inputs must fit the model’s supported context length.

blocks.en: Stage 1. Query vectors captured from all prompt–continuation rollouts are concatenated along the query-position axis for each layer. If this pool exceeds 4,096 positions, we retain 4,096 evenly spaced positions. Each update samples up to 128 query positions with replacement, shared across the layer’s heads. Full-cache attention targets are computed in chunks of 16 query positions to limit temporary memory.

blocks.en: Stage 2. Each update samples four rollouts with replacement. For each rollout, the input is its prompt concatenated with the preceding teacher-generated tokens; the document is supplied through the compacted cache. The model processes each rollout separately with a fresh continuation cache and a sequence batch size of one. Its loss is divided by four, and gradients from all four rollouts are accumulated before clipping and one AdamW step. Variable-length rollouts are neither padded together nor packed into a shared attention sequence. Distillation uses the teacher’s top 20 probabilities and aggregate tail mass, plus next-token cross-entropy (Section 3.4 ).
blocks.zh: 第二阶段 每一次更新样本 四次推出替换。 对于每次推出,输入是其与之前的师生生成的令牌同步的快速;文档通过压缩缓存提供. 模型在每次推出时分别处理一个新的续存和一个序列批量大小的序列. 其损失除以4,所有4个推出的梯度在剪接前累积,1个亚当W步骤. 可变长度的推出既未加合,也未装入共同的注意力序列。 抖动使用老师的前20个概率和总尾部质量,加上下个托肯交叉(第3.4节).

blocks.en: The uncompressed teacher follows the model’s native Hugging Face attention path. For the compacted cache, the adapter computes scaled query–key scores explicitly with PyTorch tensor operations, adds learned per-entry biases, masks padded preserver slots, and applies softmax to obtain the document attention output. It also computes the document log-normalizer with logsumexp . A separate causal PyTorch attention calculation covers prompt and generated-token entries; their output and log-normalizer are combined with the document terms using the shared softmax normalizer. Attention scores and normalizers are evaluated in FP32. The stage-1 full-cache targets likewise use explicit matrix multiplication, softmax, and logsumexp . This compacted-cache path does not call FlashAttention or PyTorch’s fused scaled-dot-product attention: it needs the log-normalizer as well as the attention output, plus per-entry biases and a ragged-slot mask. A custom fused kernel that exposes these quantities could implement the same mathematics; FlashAttention is not inherently incompatible with the method.

blocks.en: We compare with KVZip+, Attention Matching, SnapKV, and PyramidKV ( Kim et al., 2025 ; Jégou and Jeblick, 2026 ; Zweiger et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2024 ; Cai et al., 2025 ) , together with an uncompressed reference. Every compression method receives the document before its evaluation question is revealed. Attention Matching uses repeat-prefill reference queries, RMS attention-based key selection, two bounded nonnegative least-squares iterations with bounds [ e − 3 , e 3 ] [e^{-3},e^{3}] , and least-squares value fitting. This is the tested highest-attention-key variant, without on-policy query recollection or OMP. SnapKV and PyramidKV use a 32-token document observation window, mean pooling of width five, and shared GQA entries. PyramidKV uses β = 20 \beta=20 and an allocation rounded to preserve the total budget exactly. Their results describe query-agnostic adaptations.
